Weather: 7Timer and MET Norway are gone, Bright Sky (no key), WeatherAPI.com and Pirate Weather (key) are in the sources and the combined forecast, the clock and weather widget refreshes every minute and no longer stays empty, a moon at night for a clear sky, number size setting for the text widgets. Keyboard: a field's kind is read again when it changes, the photo in the bar keeps its orientation and goes after 30 seconds, copied text goes after two pastes, optional pin button, saved logins in a password box. Motion cues no longer block the notification panel. Music: no autoplay on a headset at zero volume, WMP Blob widget fixed, library chips removed. Volume keys stay volume while sound plays, Files volume keys walk the tabs. Faster APK install and a tap-to-install notification after a store download. Download delete fix. Dark PDF and Office previews in Files. PDF text search and a better Word search (Turkish letters, match case). Video list thumbnails no longer get mixed up. Processes without root show time on screen today.
